retrieval_skill.name: window_aligned_event_retrieval
retrieval_skill.description: Identify external events whose mechanisms plausibly affect the target during the forecast window, and retrieve evidence linking the event to directional changes in the measured outcome.
retrieval_skill.applicability: When forecasting a time series that may be influenced by calendars, holidays, disruptions, weather, policy changes, or other time-bounded external drivers.
retrieval_skill.query_strategy: Search using the target metric and region or system type together with the forecast-window event, expected mechanism, and baseline comparison; prioritize sources that address both timing and causal relevance.
retrieval_skill.verification_rule: Accept a claim only when reliable evidence confirms that the event overlaps the prediction window and supports the proposed directional mechanism relative to an appropriate baseline; preserve exact-quote, provenance, and temporal-window requirements and reject merely coincident or weakly related evidence.
